text_block_list.text:
The showdown of this year's Japan Cup, held at
an unprecedented venue in Nakayama Racecourse—
began with an unexpected declaration from a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I, Agnes Tachyon,
declare my entry into the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Rumor has it you've been preparing for the "Japan Cup" since late October. Could you tell us what sparked this change of heart?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Explaining it here would be too bo—er, cumbersome!
Truth is often multifaceted, after all.
Still, well, if I had to name one thing—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...
I've grown tired of seeing the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times I see it, it defies all comprehension. That recovery, that growth... Just where on earth did that flame come fromâ

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And how far she will go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...
And on top of that, the Hail Mary treatment actually worked.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "That's why I stand on my own two legs. That about sums it up. ...Satisfied?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy crap!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, holy crap, this is insane!
To think we get to see the Satsuki Sho lineup
race together again! And Cafe's here, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Who's gonna win? I mean, could it be
Symboli Kris S, who's been improving so much lately?
Then again, I'm really curious about No Reason too."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious?
Right now, it's hands down... Dantsu Flame!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I cried during that stream.
Dants is... literally me!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Dants—!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Dants!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look at that great face on you.
Man, I wanna show you off to the guys in class.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, but that ends today!
From here on out, my era makes its comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...This really is... the last time...
...That is what I intend it to be..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why... I have to catch up—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I never thought it would come to this.
I should have been more wary of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still... not bad, I suppose. I'm counting on you today. This is a major event that will divine our future path. Let's see what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Turn your blazing flame into a guiding light.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really do love everyone
so very much.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still... the star of today's show is Dantsu Flame.
Because that's how it has to be.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll take the center.
